news.title: Global Market: ECB launches blockchain payment service, to invest in digital securities
news.summary: The European Central Bank launched Pontes, a new service connecting its payment infrastructure with blockchain markets for euro settlements. The ECB also plans to invest a portion of its EUR 23 billion own funds in digital securities, while developing a retail digital euro targeted for a 2029 release.

news.title: 11 stocks added by more than 15 MF schemes in August; shares surge up to 240% in CY26
news.summary: Mutual funds added 24 stocks to their portfolios through at least 15 schemes in August 2026, with 11 of these stocks delivering over 25% YTD returns. Welspun Corp and Apar Industries emerged as the top performers, gaining 240% and 126%, respectively.

news.title: Stocks to buy: JM Financial names 9 NBFC stocks as top picks amid rate hike cycle
news.summary: Amid rising interest rates and fluctuating bond yields, JM Financial has pinpointed nine NBFCs as top stock picks. These picks showcase a diverse performance spectrum, with some stocks dipping while others have enjoyed robust gains over various timeframes. Investors are encouraged to delve into net interest margin dynamics and asset quality trends when making their selection.

news.title: Meesho shares rally 12% after UBS hikes target price by 24%. What’s keeping analysts bullish?
news.summary: UBS has raised its Meesho estimates across NMV, contribution profit and EBITDA, citing stronger seller and buyer growth and improving unit economics. The brokerage expects contribution margins to expand as logistics costs ease and advertising revenue grows. Meesho’s ability to sustain user additions, ordering frequency and NMV growth remains central to its outlook.

news.title: HDFC Bank shares hit 7-week high as RBI weighs Anup Bagchi for CEO post. What lies ahead?
news.summary: HDFC Bank shares rose to a nearly seven-week high of Rs 749.30, extending gains to 5% over three sessions, after ET reported that the RBI is weighing Anup Bagchi’s candidature for the bank’s CEO and MD post and has sought feedback from IRDAI and ICICI Bank CEO Sandeep Bakhshi.

news.title: Hindustan Copper shares gain 3% as company plans Rs 7,000 crore capital investment in next 5 years
news.summary: Hindustan Copper shares rose after the company announced a Rs 7,000 crore investment over the next 5-6 years and signed MoUs with major PSUs to expand its mining portfolio, while also partnering with Chile’s CODELCO on mining expertise and capacity building.

news.title: Embassy Developments rallies 8% after Rs 711 crore residential tower deal with Angel One founder
news.summary: Embassy Developments shares rallied up to 8% to Rs 63.80 after signing an MoU to sell an entire residential tower at Embassy Terazza in Juhu to Angel One CMD Dinesh Thakkar for Rs 711 crore. Spanning 63,000 sq ft, it is India’s largest single residential property transaction.

news.title: Textile stocks rally up to 10%: Raymond, Gokaldas Exports & others rebound after Trump tariff-triggered selloff
news.summary: Textile stocks rebounded on Tuesday, recovering most of the previous session’s losses after US President Donald Trump signed a Russia sanctions bill into law. Raymond led the gains with a 10% rally, while Pearl Global Industries, Gokaldas Exports, Arvind and Vardhman Textiles also advanced.

news.title: Motilal Oswal initiates Buy on Solar Industries, sees 24% upside. 4 reasons why
news.summary: Motilal Oswal has initiated coverage on Solar Industries with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 23,000, citing strong growth prospects across explosives and defence. The brokerage expects revenue and profit to grow at 43% and 34% CAGR, respectively, through FY30.

news.title: Pace Digitek shares jump 13% after subsidiary bags Rs 488 crore BESS order
news.summary: Pace Digitek shares surged over 13% to Rs 175.37 on Tuesday after its material subsidiary, Lineage Power, bagged a Rs 488.46-crore BESS order from NTPC GE Power Services. The project at the Barh Super Thermal Power Project involves BESS containers, maintenance, and extended warranty through December 2026.

news.title: Sensex rises 110 points, Nifty above 23,450 as oil prices, bond yields cool down. Time for a sectoral pivot?
news.summary: Indian equities traded higher as softer crude prices and easing bond yields improved sentiment. Sensex and Nifty extended gains, while broader markets also advanced. Analysts highlighted a possible sectoral shift towards fairly valued largecaps and improving technical momentum.

news.title: This stock just beat AI star HFCL’s 230% rally to top Nifty 500 gainers in 2026. Can outperformance last?
news.summary: Welspun Corp has emerged as the top-performing Nifty 500 stock in 2026 after a 236% rally, overtaking AI infrastructure play HFCL. The sharp gains have been driven by strong investor interest in the company’s oil, gas and water transmission business. The key question now is whether the rally can sustain.

news.title: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy shares rally 8% after securing Rs 985 crore domestic and global orders
news.summary: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy shares surged nearly 8% on Tuesday to Rs 186.66 after winning domestic and international orders exceeding Rs 985 crore. The orders include a 534.3 MWp solar project in Rajasthan and a 616 MWh energy storage capacity project in South Africa.

news.title: Waaree Energies shares gain 2% after company bags 2 GW solar module order
news.summary: Waaree Energies shares rose after securing a 2 GW solar module supply order from a leading domestic solar developer for FY27-FY28. The contract’s value remains undisclosed. Despite the order, the stock has declined recently and trades below seven of eight SMAs. FIIs raised their June-quarter stake, while mutual fund holdings fell.

news.title: Tata Group stocks see sharp swings as boardroom battle intensifies, but analysts say avoid the noise
news.summary: Tata Group stocks are undergoing substantial fluctuations amid an unsettling boardroom conflict as Tata Trusts questions the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Chairman. Market analysts advise investors to hone in on the core fundamentals and disregard the temporary corporate commotion. Companies like Tata Steel and Tata Motors are highlighted as sound investment choices, showing promise for long-term growth and accumulation due to their solid performance.

news.title: Polycab shares slide 17% in 3 months amid Ultravolt shock, but Jefferies sees 33% upside. What’s behind the bullish view?
news.summary: Polycab shares have fallen 17% from their June peak after UltraTech entered the wires and cables segment. Jefferies retained its Buy rating and Rs 11,100 target, implying 33% upside, citing strong demand, volume growth and Polycab’s distribution strength.

news.title: Goldman Sachs raises target on a stock that has already surged over 140% this year. Do you own it?
news.summary: Sansera Engineering shares rallied after Goldman Sachs raised its target price to Rs 4,990 from Rs 4,500 while retaining its Buy rating. The revised target implies 16.1% upside, with the stock already up over 140% in 2026. Goldman sees investments by Applied Materials and Lam Research in India supporting local supplier ecosystems and R&D, potentially driving longer-term growth for Sansera’s ADS component business.

news.title: Oracle Financial among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
news.summary: As of September 21, four NSE F&O stocks recorded an increase of over 8% in futures open interest compared to the previous trading session. Oracle Financial Services Software led the gains with an 11.43% rise, followed by Sona BLW Precision Forgings, Patanjali Foods, and BSE.

news.title: Syngene International among 4 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
news.summary: Four Nifty 500 stocks closed over 1.5% above their VWAPs on September 21, signaling stronger-than-average trading prices.

Cohance Lifesciences among 5 stocks showing RSI trending up
news.summary: Five Nifty500 stocks were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan on September 21, based on data from StockEdge. Mankind Pharma, Cohance Lifesciences, Kaynes Technology India, Fertilisers And Chemicals Travancore and Jaiprakash Power Ventures recorded rising RSI values.

news.title: Moneyview pays Rs 160 crore incentive to CEO ahead of IPO; FY26 profit takes 30% hit
news.summary: IPO-bound Moneyview paid CEO Puneet Agarwal a one-time Rs 160 crore performance incentive in FY26, reducing reported net profit by about Rs 120 crore after tax. The company said the payment was non-recurring and has no plans for similar incentives. Moneyview’s Rs 1,092-crore IPO opens September 24 at Rs 32-34.

news.title: Engineers India among 4 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
news.summary: Four Nifty500 stocks appeared on the White Marubozu bullish scanner on September 21, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. Engineers India, Mankind Pharma, Aditya Infotech and UTI Asset Management Company recorded gains during the session.
